$sources: The species: Narcissus pseudonarcissus L., wild daffodil: a bulb, the leaves linear, 12-35 cm by 5-12 mm, glaucous; a single nodding flower 3.5-6 cm, the perianth pale yellow, the corona a long trumpet, deeper yellow; flowering March to April, the leaves dying back by June (C. Stace, New Flora of the British Isles, 4th ed., Cambridge 2019, Amaryllidaceae).
The bulbs at the Hall of Light's plotted points (the as-built orchard, HallOfLightPlanting.swift), heights 0.20-0.35.
name: Narcissus pseudonarcissus
note: Out of flower in June, its leaves yellowing as they die back after flowering. The museum shows it in early summer, Mangzhong to Xiazhi (June).
